title: Adafruit product 381: Waterproof 1-Wire DS18B20 Digital temperature sensor (product page: Description, Technical Details)
supports: identity: pre-wired, waterproofed (with heat shrink) DS18B20 sensor; genuine Maxim DS18B20 tested since January 2021
Cable specs: stainless steel tube 6 mm diameter by 30 mm long; cable 36 in / 91 cm long, 4 mm diameter; PVC jacket, keep under 100 C
wiring: three wires red 3-5 V, blue/black ground, yellow/white data; four-wire version red 3-5 V, black ground, white data, copper wire soldered to the shielding
4.7k resistor supplied, required as a pull-up from DATA to VCC
usable temperature range -55 to 125 C; +-0.5 C from -10 to +85 C; 9 to 12 bit resolution; query time less than 750 ms; usable with 3.0-5.5 V power/data (description: 3.0-5.0 V systems)
not for salt water or corrosive environments; not IP rated; not guaranteed for long-term or high-pressure use
links the DS18B20 datasheet (https://cdn-shop.adafruit.com/datasheets/DS18B20.pdf)

title: Maxim Integrated (Analog Devices) DS18B20 Programmable Resolution 1-Wire Digital Thermometer, 19-7487 Rev 6, 7/19
supports: Absolute Maximum Ratings: any pin -0.5 to +6.0 V; operating and storage -55 to +125 C

DC Electrical Characteristics: VDD 3.0-5.5 V (local and parasite power); VPU 3.0 V to VDD (local power); thermometer error +-0.5 C (-10 to +85 C), +-1 C (-30 to +100 C), +-2 C (-55 to +125 C); VIL -0.3 to 0.8 V; VIH 2.2 V (local power) to the lower of 5.5 V or VDD + 0.3 V; sink current 4.0 mA min at 0.4 V; standby 750 nA typ, 1000 nA max; active 1 mA typ, 1.5 mA max (VDD = 5 V); DQ input current 5 uA typ; drift +-0.2 C
AC Electrical Characteristics: tCONV 93.75 / 187.5 / 375 / 750 ms max at 9 / 10 / 11 / 12 bits; tSLOT 60-120 us; tRSTL 480 us min; CIN/OUT 25 pF max; NV write 10 ms max
Pin Description: TO-92 pin 1 GND, pin 2 DQ (open-drain 1-Wire data I/O; parasite power), pin 3 VDD (optional; grounded for parasite power)
Overview: 64-bit ROM code, family code 28h; default 12-bit resolution at power-up; resolution 0.5 / 0.25 / 0.125 / 0.0625 C

Powering the DS18B20: parasite power needs a strong pull-up within 10 us of Convert T, not recommended above +100 C; external supply on VDD frees the bus during conversion (Figure 7, 4.7 kOhm pull-up)
1-Wire Bus System: external pull-up of approximately 5 kOhm; idle state high; bus held low more than 480 us resets all devices
Ordering Information: TO-92, 8-pin SO and 8-pin uSOP packages
